title: JupyterHub console is reachable without authentication
description: The JupyterHub sign-in page is served publicly. JupyterHub provisions a notebook server per user, and any account that reaches it gets a shell with whatever mounts the spawner attaches.
remediation: Keep JupyterHub behind the identity provider and the internal network; treat its sign-in page as an administrative surface, not a public page.
limitation: One response body. The rule recognises the JupyterHub console shell from its document title; it does not attempt a login, so it shows that the interface is served, not which data the caller could read.

observation.body: <html><head><title>Sign in · JupyterHub</title></head><body><form method="post" action="/login"><input name="user"><input type="password" name="pass"><button>Sign in</button></form></body></html>
